steps.borderless: Set League to Borderless: Xyra switches it for you from Home.
steps.pick: When you pick a champion, Xyra sets your runes, spells and items and tells you who to take from the bench or who counters your opponent.
steps.cards: In ARAM: Mayhem and Arena, take the card with the red frame: it is the best for your champion.
steps.meta: Before playing, check Meta for the best champions of the patch and the buffs and nerfs to yours.

noLabels.question: I cannot see the labels over the game
noLabels.answer: Make sure League is in Borderless mode, Xyra is not paused and the game is focused. In exclusive fullscreen Windows does not allow drawing on top.

misplaced.question: Labels look misplaced
misplaced.answer: Adjust height and size in Labels → Calibration and check them with the Test button.

grades.question: What do S, A, B, C mean?
grades.answer: It is the OP.GG tier of that augment with your champion: S is excellent and from C down you should reroll. "Rare pick" means almost nobody takes it with that champion, so there is not enough data.

ban.question: Can I get banned for using it?
ban.answer: Xyra only reads the screen and draws on top, like OBS or Discord: it never touches the game. Details in the Security tab.

runes.question: My runes are not imported
runes.answer: League must be open and you need a free rune page. Xyra only replaces the pages it created.

ocr.question: Xyra does not recognize the cards
ocr.answer: Windows needs text recognition for your client language: add it in Settings → Time & language → Language.

notify.question: How does my phone let me know when I find a match?
notify.answer: With the app paired and "Tell me about the match" on in its Settings, a notification rings even with the app closed, and you can accept from it. While it waits you will see a pinned Xyra notification.

bench.question: What does "Take from the bench" do?
bench.answer: In ARAM, when the bench has a better champion than yours by the order you chose for recommendations, the button swaps it for you, just as clicking it in the client. It only acts when you press it.

patch.question: Where do the buffs and nerfs come from?
patch.answer: From the official patch notes. Xyra compares the numbers of each change to mark it as a buff, a nerf or an adjustment; open it in Meta to see the details and Riot's reason.

order.question: How does Xyra choose which champion to recommend?
order.answer: By OP.GG's tier, your mastery, what you play the most or a mix. Change it on Home or from your phone.

away.question: Does the phone work away from home?
away.answer: No: your phone has to be on the same Wi-Fi as your PC. That way nothing goes through the internet.

update.question: How does it update?
update.answer: Xyra tells you when there is a new version and updates with one button in Settings → About, without uninstalling or losing your data. The phone app updates from its Settings.

support: Turn on "Save screenshots" in General, repeat what failed and tell us on GitHub with the screenshot and the log.

phoneSteps.install: Install the Xyra app for Android from the downloads.
phoneSteps.turnOn: Here, in Settings → Phone, turn on the link and accept the Windows prompt.
phoneSteps.scan: Scan the code with the app: it lets you know when you find a match, even with the app closed.
